If the wearer is struck a Killing Blow, they are permitted armour and Regeneration saves as normal. If the wound is unsaved, they lose a single Wound.

foe-bane.description: This strangely twisted Elven blade was taken from the body of a Chaos champion. Quite how they came to possess it is unknown, as is the name of the brave Elf that reclaimed it.
foe-bane.body: Notes: When the wielder of Foe Bane makes a roll To Wound, a roll of 4+ is always a success, regardless of the target's Toughness.

woodsman-s-axe.description: Wrought from purest Ithilmar, in the strong hands of a Chracian champion, this axe can cleave the skull of even the foulest beast with a single stroke.
woodsman-s-axe.body: Notes: The Woodsman's Axe may only be taken by models in a Chracian Warhost Army of Infamy.

moonstone-of-the-hidden-ways.description: Some of the most mysterious hidden pathways within the depths of Athel Loren can only be unlocked with the power of ancient moonstones.
moonstone-of-the-hidden-ways.body: Single Use. The wearer of the Moonstone of Hidden Ways may cast the Forest Walker spell from the Lore of Athel Loren as a Bound spell with a Power Level of 3.

dragon-helm.description: Crafted into the likeness of a great wyrm, the Dragon Helm remembers the heat of its forging, protecting its wearer from the touch of flame.
dragon-helm.body: May be worn with other armour. The wearer of the Dragon Helm improves their armour value by 1 (to a maximum of 2+). In addition, its wearer has a 6+ Ward save against any wounds suffered that were caused by an attack that has the Flaming Attacks special rule.

banner-of-midsummer-s-eve.description: Glimmering with the light of the midsummer sun, this shining pennant reveals the enemies of Athel Loren no matter where they may try to hide.
banner-of-midsummer-s-eve.body: A unit carrying the Banner of Midsummer's Eve gains the Ignores Cover special rule.

the-golden-shield.description: A highly polished shield inlaid with swirling patterns, the Golden Shield dazzles the foe.
the-golden-shield.body: The Golden Shield is a shield. In addition, any enemy model that directs its attacks against its bearer during the Combat phase must re-roll any rolls To Hit of a natural 6.

sacred-incense.description: This bundle of incense, blessed by the wardens of the Shrine of Asuryan, will burn for days, wreathing its bearer with the scented smoke of the temples.
sacred-incense.body: Any enemy model that targets this character or any unit they have joined during the Shooting phase suffers an additional -1 To Hit modifier.

circlet-of-atrazar.description: This gem-studded circlet radiates an aura that protects its wearer from harm.
circlet-of-atrazar.body: The wearer of the Circlet of Atrazar has +1 Wound on their profile. In addition, if the bearer's troop type is infantry or cavalry, they have a +1 modifier to their Toughness characteristic.

banner-of-arcane-protection.description: The heavy fabric of this banner is interwoven with powerful protective charms.
banner-of-arcane-protection.body: A unit carrying the Banner of Arcane Protection gains the Magic Resistance (-3) special rule. In addition, friendly units within 6" of the model carrying this standard gain the Magic Resistance (-1) special rule.

opal-amulet.description: Potent yet fragile, an Opal Amulet offers powerful protection, but can easily be broken.
opal-amulet.body:
Single use. An Opal Amulet gives its bearer a 2+ Ward save against a single wound.
*Extremely Common

banner-of-resilience.description: Adorned with a thousand emerald Dragon scales, the power of this ancient banner infuses the Elves that fight beneath it.
banner-of-resilience.body: A unit carrying the Banner of Resilience has a +1 modifier to its Toughness characteristic.

banner-of-ellyrion.description: This depiction of Korhandir, the father of all horses, imbues a regiment with tireless energy.
banner-of-ellyrion.body: A unit carrying the Banner of Ellyrion gains the Move Through Cover special rule.

battle-banner.description: This intricate banner, festooned with gemstones, bears detailed scenes of Ulthuan's victories.
battle-banner.body: When calculating its combat result, a unit carrying the Battle Banner may claim an additional bonus of +D3 combat result points.

the-banner-of-lothern.description: The Banner of Lothern is borne aloft by those that exemplify the martial spirit of the Sea Guard.
the-banner-of-lothern.body: If a unit carrying the Banner of Lothern is equipped with thrusting spears, half of the models in the third rank or file i.e., the rank or file directly behind the one normally able to make supporting attacks), rounding up, can make supporting attacks.

the-blade-of-leaping-gold.description: To the valiant, the Blade of Leaping Gold lends supernatural speed and vigour; to the craven and the corrupt, it brings only swift death. A more finely balanced sword than this has never been made.
the-blade-of-leaping-gold.body: Armour Bane (2), Extra Attacks (+D3), Magical Attacks

lion-standard.description: The renowned courage of a Chracian Lion fills the hearts of those who serve under this banner.
lion-standard.body: A unit carrying the Lion Standard automatically passes any Fear or Terror tests it is required to make.

amulet-of-the-tempest.description: About this delicate and unadorned silver amulet the Winds of Magic boil with a storm's fury, confounding the wits of enemy Wizards.
amulet-of-the-tempest.body: The Amulet of the Tempest may only be taken by a model in a Sea Guard Garrison Army of Infamy. Whilst within 9" of the bearer of the Amulet of the Tempest, enemy Wizards cannot add their Level of Wizardry to their Casting rolls.

null-stone.description: Those with the Mage sight see the bearer of this smooth, black stone pendant as a dark void, an unsettling patch of nothingness in the realm of magic.
null-stone.body:
Whilst within the Command range of the bearer, all Wizards (friend or foe) suffer a -1 modifier to their Casting and Dispel rolls.
In addition, during the Command sub-phase of their turn, if they are not engaged in combat, this character may attempt to use the Null Stone by making a Leadership test (using their own unmodified Leadership). If this test is passed, until your next Start of Turn sub-phase, this character cannot be targeted by any spells and is immune to the effects of
any spells.

the-cloak-of-beards.description: An aura of fear and anger hangs about this grisly trophy of the War of the Beard, filling allies and enemies alike with unease.
the-cloak-of-beards.body: The wearer of the Cloak of Beards causes Terror. However, so unnerving is the cloak that other models cannot use the wearer's Leadership.

banner-of-confidence.description: This silken standard fills the hearts of those that fight beneath it with confidence.
banner-of-confidence.body: A unit carrying the Banner of Confidence does not suffer the usual -1 To Hit modifier when making a Stand & Shoot charge reaction.

gem-of-courage.description: Enchanted by Celaer in the reign of Bel-Korhadris, these small gems are awarded by the Phoenix King to the boldest heroes of Ulthuan in recognition of their bravery.
gem-of-courage.body:
A Gem of Courage may only be taken by a model in a Chracian Warhost Army of Infamy. Single use. Once per game, when required to make a Break test, the bearer of a Gem of Courage (and their unit) may roll an extra D6 and discard the highest result.
*Extremely Common

sigil-of-asuryan.description: The sigil is tattooed on the hand of the Mage using inks prepared in the sacred flame of Asuryan itself. After use it quickly fades to nothing.
sigil-of-asuryan.body:
Single use. A Wizard may use this item instead of making a dispel attempt. If they do so, the spell is automatically dispelled with no Dispel roll required.
Note that a perfect invocation cannot be dispelled.
*Extremely Common

the-loremaster-s-cloak.description: Wrapped in this pale grey cloak, the wearer seems somehow insubstantial and almost illusory.
the-loremaster-s-cloak.body: The bearer of the Loremaster's Cloak and any unit they have joined has a 4+ Ward save against any wounds suffered that were caused by a Magic Missile.

ring-of-fury.description: The Elves of Ulthuan are known for their skill at crafting magical rings, and black iron Rings of Fury are popular amongst Elven warriors.
ring-of-fury.body:
The wielder of the Ring of Fury can cast the Hammerhand spell from the Lore of Battle Magic as a Bound spell, with a Power Level of 1.
*Extremely Common

banner-of-balance.description: The fabric of this banner is steeped in magical energies and interwoven with powerful charms.
banner-of-balance.body: Whilst in base contact with a unit carrying the Banner of Balance, enemy units cannot re-roll any rolls To Hit or To Wound. However, nor can the unit carrying the Banner of Balance.

seed-of-rebirth.description: A seed from the heart of Athel Loren, gifted to the High Elves by their distant kin, the bearer is imbued with life-giving magic.
seed-of-rebirth.body: The Seed of Rebirth gives its bearer the Regeneration (5+) special rule.

the-vortex-shard.description: Hewn from a shattered Waystone, the Vortex Shard has the power to becalm the Winds of Magic.
the-vortex-shard.body: Single use. A Wizard may use this item instead of making a dispel attempt. If they do so, the spell is automatically dispelled with no Dispel roll required. In addition, all Remains in Play spells currently in play are dispelled, including spells cast by friendly Wizards.

annulian-crystal.description: Dug from beneath the Annulii Mountains, this crystal has been shaped by the magical vortex that swathes Ulthuan, so that it draws magical energy towards it.
annulian-crystal.body:
Once per turn, upon successfully casting a spell, the bearer of the Annulian Crystal can choose to forget that spell and immediately generate another (not including signature spells) in the usual manner.
Note that it is possible the Wizard might generate the spell they just forgot, or one forgotten in a previous turn. Consider it fate.

anointed-of-asuryan.description: In matters both martial and spiritual, the Phoenix Guard take their lead from the Anointed of Asuryan, learned sages that have for centuries been immersed in Asuryan's teachings.
anointed-of-asuryan.body:
A character with the Anointed of Asuryan Elven Honour:
May be mounted on a Flamespyre Phoenix or a Frostheart Phoenix (but cannot choose any other mount options).

May be equipped with a ceremonial halberd for no additional points. If so, they may not take any additional, non-magical weapons.

Gains the Blessings of Asuryan, Fear and Witness to Destiny special rules.

Replaces the Valour of Ages special rule with the Veteran special rule.

shadow-stalker.description: Like all denizens of Nagarythe, Shadow Stalkers are outcasts. Many choose to travel far beyond the borders of Ulthuan, fighting unseen wars in the eternal defence of their homeland.
shadow-stalker.body:
A character with the Shadow Stalker Elven Honour:
Cannot be mounted.

May be equipped with a bow of Avelorn for no additional points. If so, they may not take any additional, non-magical weapons.

Cannot have heavy armour or full plate armour.

Gains the Ambushers, Evasive, Fire & Flee, Move Through Cover and Scouts special rules

silvery-wand.description: This slender wand is covered with many intricately carved lines of winding runes in an ancient script.
silvery-wand.body:
The bearer of the Silvery Wand knows one more spell (chosen in the usual way) than is normal for their Level of Wizardry.
Note that this does not increase the Wizard's Level.

staff-of-solidity.description: The Staff of Solidity absorbs and dissipates malign energy, protecting its wielder from harm.
staff-of-solidity.body: Single use. Once per game, when the bearer of the Staff of Solidity is required to roll on the Miscast table, they may choose not to.

chracian-hunter.description: In Chrace, a warrior's skill at arms and strength of character matters almost as much as the nobility of their blood, and the foremost warriors quickly rise to prominence within the ranks of the White Lions.
chracian-hunter.body:
A character with the Chracian Hunter Elven Honour (but not their mount):
May only be mounted on a White Lion Chariot (but cannot choose any other mount options).

May be equipped with a Chracian great blade for no additional points. If so, they may not take any additional, non-magical weapons.

Gains the Lion Cloak, Move Through Cover and Stubborn special rules.

blood-of-caledor.description: Ulthuan was once dominated by the valour and wisdom of Caledor's Dragon Princes. Today, the royal bloodline has faded, yet the haughty pride of Caledor's warrior elite still shines bright.
blood-of-caledor.body:
A character with the Blood of Caledor Elven Honour (but not their mount):
Must be mounted on either a Barded Elven Steed, a Sun Dragon, a Moon Dragon, or a Star Dragon.

Has a +1 modifier to their Weapon Skill characteristic.

May be equipped with full plate armour for no additional points.

Gains the Dragon Armour and Impetuous special rules.

warden-of-saphery.description: When Ulthuan marches to war, the Swordmasters of Hoeth are led by the Wardens of Saphery, exemplars of the martial arts who have studied warfare and personal combat for decades.
warden-of-saphery.body:
A character with the Warden of Saphery Elven Honour:
Cannot be mounted.

May be equipped with a sword of Hoeth for no additional points. If so, they may not take any additional, non-magical weapons.

Gains the Deflect Shots, Ithilmar Armour and Killing Blow special rules.

loremaster.description: Amongst the seers and scholars that reside within the Tower of Hoeth, there are those that practise both the mystical and martial arts as one. Such dedication marks a Loremaster from a mere scholar.
loremaster.body:
High Elf Lords only. A character with the Loremaster Elven Honour:
Cannot be mounted.

Is a Level 1 Wizard and knows one randomly generated spell from one of the following Lores of Magic:
Battle Magic

Elementalism

High Magic

Illusion

May be equipped with a Sword of Hoeth for no additional points. If so, they may not take any additional, non-magical weapons.

Gains the Ithilmar Armour, Lileath's Blessing and Lore of Saphery special rules.

black-hammer-of-hashut.description: This burning, black-hafted hammer bears the horned rune of Hashut, Father of Darkness, and has been carried into battle for centuries by the champions of Zharr-Naggrund.
black-hammer-of-hashut.body: Notes: Against models with the Flammable special rule, this weapon also has the Killing Blow special rule.

dagger-of-malice.description: Said to have been found in an ancient barrow, this hooked blade whispers tales of murder and violence to any that grasp its hilt. Its edge has never dulled, no matter how many lives it has taken.
dagger-of-malice.body: Notes: Unlike other Frenzied models, the wielder of the Dagger of Malice cannot lose this special rule.

pure-of-heart.description: Though Ulthuan's Golden Age is a distant memory, there are still a few nobles that embody all that is glorious about the High Elves, their presence reminding others of the heroic past of their race.
pure-of-heart.body: Unless this character is fleeing, all friendly units within their Command range can use their Leadership characteristic instead of their own. In addition, this character and any unit it has joined automatically passes any Panic test it is required to make.

the-graven-sceptre.description: A badge of rank carried by the lords of Gorgoth, this iron staff carries the runic names of the masters of the Black Fortress since its founding, bound up with the baleful prayers of Hashut.
the-graven-sceptre.body: Notes: When making a roll To Wound for a hit caused with the Graven Sceptre, a roll of 4+ is always a success, regardless of the target's Toughness.

dark-maul.description: This mysterious weapon of unknown origin smoulders with a dark power that seems to eat the light around it and devours the warmth of its victims, leaving them withered husks.
dark-maul.body: Notes: Any enemy model that suffers one or more unsaved wounds from the Dark Maul must immediately make a Strength test. If this test is failed, the enemy model loses an additional Wound.

armour-of-bazherak-the-cruel.description: Once worn by the Castellan of the Tower of Gorgoth, this armour was pulled from the Bitter Sea along with its owner's drowned corpse to stand as a warning to the arrogant of the price of hubris.
armour-of-bazherak-the-cruel.body: The Armour of Bazherak the Cruel is a suit of full plate armour. In addition, its wearer has the Immune to Psychology and Magic Resistance (-2) special rules.

sea-guard.description: Many nobles of Lothern choose to serve within the ranks of the Sea Guard, rising quickly to command the disciplined ranks of Ulthuan's navy and hone their skill on distant battlefields.
sea-guard.body:
A character with the Sea Guard Elven Honour:
May only be mounted on a Lothern Skycutter (but cannot choose any other mount options).

May be equipped with a warbow for no additional points. If so, they may not take any additional, non-magical weapons.

Gains the Naval Discipline and Rallying Cry special rules.

the-mask-of-the-furnace.description: This iron mask contains the essence and agonies of all who have perished before it in the fires of sacrifice.
the-mask-of-the-furnace.body: May be worn with other armour. The wearer of the Mask of the Furnace improves their armour value by 1 (to a maximum of 2+). In addition, they have a 3+ Ward save against any wounds suffered that were caused by an attack that has the Flaming Attacks special rule.

ashen-banner.description: Clouds of soot and ash billow from this smouldering pennant, concealing its bearers from their enemies.
ashen-banner.body: Any enemy model that targets a unit carrying the Ashen Banner during the Shooting phase suffers an additional -1 To Hit modifier.

the-trickster-s-pendant.description: Though the pendants worn by devotees of Loec the Trickster are simple, they are loaded with power.
the-trickster-s-pendant.body: Single use. A Wizard may use the Trickster's Pendant when attempting a Wizardly dispel. If they do so, roll an extra D6 when making the Dispel roll and discard the lowest result. If the spell is dispelled, the Wizard that attempted to cast it cannot attempt to cast any more spells for the remainder of the current turn. However, if a double 1 is rolled on any two of the dice rolled, the bearer is outclassed in the art.

hellshard.description: The malice of its wearer resides within the Hellshard's black depths, waiting to be unleashed on any who would dare spill their blood.
hellshard.body: If the bearer of the Hellshard loses their last Wound to an enemy attack during the Combat phase, the unit that made the attack suffers D6 Strength 5 hits, each with an AP of -1.

mantle-of-stone.description: Stitched from the flayed flesh of failed sorcerer-apprentices, a Stone Mantle preserves the wearer and reminds them of failure's price.
mantle-of-stone.body:
The wearer of a Mantle of Stone has a +1 modifier to their Toughness characteristic, but a -1 modifier to their Initiative characteristic.
*Extremely Common

breath-of-hashut.description: Through the blackest of sorceries, the breath of Hashut can be sealed within an earthen jar and unleashed upon his foes.
breath-of-hashut.body: Single use. The Breath of Hashut is a breath weapon with the following profile:

daemonic-familiar.description: The Chaos Dwarfs bind many daemonic creatures to their will. In battle, these entities cluster about their master's enemies, feeding hungrily upon the wards that protect them.
daemonic-familiar.body: Enemy models engaged in combat with the owner of a Daemonic Familiar must reduce the armour value of any Ward or Regeneration save they have by 1, to a minimum of 6+.

shroud-of-the-ancestor.description: Those that march beneath this black pennant, supposedly torn from the corpse of an unnamed Ancestor in ages past, seethe with rage towards their hated western kin.
shroud-of-the-ancestor.body: A unit carrying the Shroud of the Ancestor gains the Hatred (Dwarfs) special rule.

vial-of-lammasu-blood.description: The blood of a Lammasu is a powerful ward against magic. Consuming it still warm allows a sorcerer to dispel the petty conjurations of their rivals with ease.
vial-of-lammasu-blood.body:
Single use. A Wizard may use this item instead of making a dispel attempt. If they do so, the spell is automatically dispelled with no Dispel roll required.
Note that a perfect invocation cannot be dispelled.

obsidian-vambraces.description: Carved of cold, hard obsidian, these powerful yet fragile artefacts ward against magic.
obsidian-vambraces.body: The wearer of the Obsidian Vambraces has a +1 modifier to their Strength characteristic and the Magic Resistance (-1) special rule. However, if they roll a natural 1 when making a roll To Hit during the Combat phase, the gauntlets shatter into pieces and can no longer be used.

daemon-flask.description: This rune-inscribed vessel holds a raging daemonic entity of phenomenal power. When unleashed its screams can shatter stone and cause the ground to split asunder as it flees into the æther.
daemon-flask.body: Single use. During the Command sub-phase of their turn, the bearer of the Daemon Flask may open it. When they do so, all enemy units that are within this character's Command range must make a Panic test.

blade-of-revered-tzunki.description: Supposedly wielded by the legendary Tzunki, this exquisite weapon hums as it cuts through the air.
blade-of-revered-tzunki.body: Notes: No armour or Ward saves are permitted against wounds caused by the Blade of Revered Tzunki (Regeneration saves can be attempted as normal).

piranha-blade.description: The blade of this weapon is inlaid with thousands of tiny barbed teeth that rip and tear through the flesh of the enemy.

scroll-of-binding.description: Chaos Dwarf Sorcerers make many foul bargains with Daemons, hoping to increase their powers. These infernal contracts are etched in blood upon scrolls of binding.
scroll-of-binding.body:
Single use. A Wizard may use this scroll when attempting to cast a spell. If they do so, the Wizard rolls 3D6 when making their Casting roll (rather than the usual 2D6). However, if a double 1 is rolled on any two of the dice rolled, the spell is miscast.
*Extremely Common

staff-of-the-lost-sun.description: Made of an alien metal, the Staff of the Lost Sun projects beams of hot light from its tip, searing the flesh of those caught in the blast.
staff-of-the-lost-sun.body:
Ranged:
Combat:
Notes: The Staff of the Lost Sun has two profiles, representing its use as both a combat and missile weapon.

scimitar-of-the-sun-resplendent.description: As light as a dagger, this curved blade invigorates its wielder with the power of the sun.
scimitar-of-the-sun-resplendent.body: Extra Attacks (+D3), Flaming Attacks, Magical Attacks

skavenpelt-banner.description: The stench of this ragged Skaven hide fires the blood of those who venerate Sotek.
skavenpelt-banner.body: A unit carrying the Skavenpelt Banner gains the Frenzy and Hatred (Skaven) special rules.

the-lammasu-s-beard.description: This totem depicts the leering face of an old man, beneath which bristles a blood-stained beard torn from the chin of an ancient Lammasu.
the-lammasu-s-beard.body: A unit carrying the Lammasu's Beard has a 6+ Ward save against any wounds suffered and gains the Magic Resistance (-2) special rule. In addition, whilst within 6" of the model carrying this standard, friendly units have a 5+ Ward save against any wounds suffered during the Shooting phase and gain the Magic Resistance (-1) special rule.

hide-of-the-cold-ones.description: The hide of a Cold One exudes a toxic slime that dulls the wearer's mind.
hide-of-the-cold-ones.body: May be worn with other armour. The wearer of the Hide of the Cold Ones improves their armour value by 1 (to a maximum of 2+). However, its wearer is also subject to the Stupidity special rule.

glyph-necklace.description: This ancient token of protection wards off attacks, causing enemies to fumble their blows.
glyph-necklace.body: The bearer of the Glyph Necklace has a 5+ Ward save against any wounds suffered and gains the Magic Resistance (-2) special rule.

totem-of-prophecy.description: Those who look upon this totem witness the truth and learn of their insignificance in the scheme of the Old Ones.
totem-of-prophecy.body: A unit carrying the Totem of Prophecy gains the Fear special rule.

shield-of-the-mirror-pool.description: Hostile enemy magic is absorbed by this ancient shield, and reflected back upon the caster.
shield-of-the-mirror-pool.body: The Shield of the Mirror Pool is a shield. In addition, each time the bearer loses one or more Wounds to a Magic Missile, the caster suffers a single Strength 5 hit with an AP of -2.

aura-of-quetzl.description: Blessed by Quetzl, this string of beaded shells, feathers and bones exudes a powerful protective aura.
aura-of-quetzl.body: Any enemy model that directs its attacks against the bearer of the Aura of Quetzl during the Combat phase suffers a -1 modifier to its rolls To Hit.

jaguar-standard.description: Those in the shadow of this jungle beast hunt down their enemies with relentless ferocity.
jaguar-standard.body: When a unit carrying the Jaguar Standard makes a Pursuit roll, it may roll an extra D6 and discard the lowest result.

sun-standard-of-chotec.description: Beams of reflected sunlight blind all who look too long upon the Sun Standard of Chotec.
sun-standard-of-chotec.body: Enemy units cannot declare a Stand & Shoot charge reaction against a unit carrying the Sun Standard of Chotec. In addition, any enemy model that targets a unit carrying this banner during the Shooting phase suffers an additional -1 To Hit modifier.

cloak-of-feathers.description: When the wearer of this finely woven cloak extends their arms, the feathers rise up like powerful wings, lifting them into the air.
cloak-of-feathers.body: Skink Heroes whose troop type is infantry only. The wearer of the Cloak of Feathers gains the Fly (10) and Swiftstride special rules.

venom-of-the-firefly-frog.description: Extracted from the rare and deadly firefly frog, even a tiny amount of this poison can prove fatal.
venom-of-the-firefly-frog.body:
All attacks made during the Combat phase by the bearer of the Venom of the Firefly Frog have the Poisoned Attacks and Flaming Attacks special rules.
Note that this only applies to non-magical weapons and does not apply to a model's mount (should it have one).

itxi-grub.description: The Wizard carries a gourd containing magically charged (and delicious) Itxi grubs.
itxi-grub.body:
Single use. Before making a Casting roll, the bearer may attempt to consume a single Itxi Grub by making a Toughness test. If this test is passed, the bearer may apply a +3 modifier to the Casting roll. However, if this test is failed, the bearer immediately loses a single Wound.
*Extremely Common

becalming-cogitation.description: With a belching croak, the Slann smothers the power of enemy spells.
becalming-cogitation.body: Once per turn, the Slann Mage-Priest may re-roll one of the D6 when making a Wizardly dispel attempt. In addition, this character increases their Dispel range by 3".

cube-of-darkness.description: Through careful contemplation, this small black cube may be opened for a fraction of a second, drawing the Winds of Magic into its depths.
cube-of-darkness.body:
Single use. A Wizard may use this item instead of making a dispel attempt. If they do so, the spell is automatically dispelled with no Dispel roll required. In addition, all remains in play spells currently in play are dispelled, including spells cast by friendly Wizards.
*Extremely Common

transcendent-healing.description: By force of will alone, the Slann heals the wounds inflicted upon its body.
transcendent-healing.body: This character gains the Regeneration (5+) special rule.

horned-one.description: Horned Ones are a very rare, highly intelligent and preternaturally swift sub-species of Cold One.
horned-one.body:
This magic item may only be taken by a Saurus Hero mounted on a Cold One. This character's mount loses the Stupidity special rule and has Movement characteristic of 8.
*Extremely Common

overseer-s-sigil.description: Beneath this hateful banner the workers of Zharr-Naggrund must swear devotion to their dark masters.
overseer-s-sigil.body: Whilst within 9" of the model carrying the Overseer's Sigil, friendly units lose the Levies special rule.

higher-state-of-mind.description: So deep are the thoughts of the Mage-Priest that its physical body becomes a ghostly image as it slips further away from this reality.
higher-state-of-mind.body: This character gains the Ethereal special rule.

wandering-deliberations.description: The wandering mind of the Slann reflects upon the nature of many and varied magical disciplines.
wandering-deliberations.body: Instead of generating spells normally, this character knows four signature spells, chosen from the following Lores of Magic: Battle Magic, Daemonology, Dark Magic, Elementalism, High Magic, Illusion and Necromancy. The character may discard one of these signature spells in favour of a spell from the Lore of Lustria.

cupped-hands-of-the-old-ones.description: A sphere of glowing light extends around the bearer as the divine protection of the Old Ones deflects the uncontrolled maelstrom of the Winds of Magic.
cupped-hands-of-the-old-ones.body: Should the bearer of the Cupped Hands of the Old Ones miscast a spell, roll a D6. On a roll of 1, the bearer rolls on the Miscast table as normal. On a roll of 2+, the bearer instead nominates an enemy character. Centre a 3" blast template over this character. Every model whose base lies underneath the template risks being hit and suffering a single Strength 6 hit with an AP of -2.

sorcerous-void.description: Closing its eyes and breathing deeply, the Slann Mage-Priest calms the Winds of Magic, causing enemy spells to falter and fail.
sorcerous-void.body: This character gains the Magic Resistance (-D3) special rule. Roll the D3 before armies are deployed.

soul-of-stone.description: Both the mind and body of the Slann Mage-Priest is hardened against the ill effects of magic.
soul-of-stone.body: When rolling on the Miscast table, this character can modify the result by -1 (to a minimum of 2), or by +1 (to a maximum of 12).

harrowing-scrutiny.description: The unblinking gaze of this Slann Mage-Priest carries a measure of the scrutiny of the Old Ones.
harrowing-scrutiny.body: This character gains the Terror special rule.

lifetaker.description: Finely fashioned from blackest steel, Lifetaker fires bolts dipped in the venom of a Black Dragon.
lifetaker.body: Armour Bane (1), Magical Attacks, Multiple Shots (D3+1), Poisoned Attacks

sword-of-ruin.description: The wickedly sharp edge of the Sword of Ruin can cleave through armour as if it were air.
sword-of-ruin.body: Notes: No armour, Ward or Regeneration saves are permitted against wounds caused by the Sword of Ruin.

whip-of-agony.description: An heirloom of the feared Beastlords of clan Rakarth, the Whip of Agony inflicts enduring torment upon its victims.
whip-of-agony.body: Notes: High Beastmasters only. Any enemy model that suffers one or more unsaved wounds from the Whip of Agony suffers a -1 modifier to its Toughness characteristic (to a minimum of 1) for the remainder of the game.

blood-armour.description: When anointed with the blood of the foe, this armour becomes ever more endurable.
blood-armour.body: Models whose troop type is infantry or cavalry only. The Blood Armour is a suit of armour that gives its wearer an armour value of 5+. For each unsaved wound the wearer inflicts, this armour value is improved by 1, to a maximum of 2+.

cold-blooded-banner.description: Those that march beneath this Cold One blood-soaked banner display a steely discipline.
cold-blooded-banner.body: Single use. A unit carrying the Cold-blooded Banner may use it when making any test against its Leadership characteristic, including a Break test. When it does, it may roll an extra D6 and discard the highest result.

shield-of-ghrond.description: The Daemon-faced Shield of Ghrond consumes the strength of the enemy's attacks
shield-of-ghrond.body: The Shield of Ghrond is a shield. In addition, all attacks directed against its bearer suffer a -1 modifier to their Strength characteristic (to a minimum of 1).

banner-of-nagarythe.description: The personal banner of the Dread-King proclaims his reign over the Elven Kingdoms.
banner-of-nagarythe.body: A unit carrying the Banner of Nagarythe gains the Stubborn special rule. In addition, when calculating its combat result, the unit may claim an additional bonus of +1 combat result point.

standard-of-slaughter.description: Anointed with the blood of an Ulthuan Elf, this banner exudes a sense of bitter determination.
standard-of-slaughter.body: When calculating its combat result during a turn in which it charged, a unit carrying the Standard of Slaughter may claim an additional bonus of +D3 combat result points.

pearl-of-infinite-bleakness.description: Swirled with red and black veins, this magical pearl emits a soul-numbing aura.
pearl-of-infinite-bleakness.body: The bearer of the Pearl of Infinite Bleakness and any unit they have joined gains the Immune to Psychology special rule.

banner-of-har-ganeth.description: Under the influence of this ancient banner, warriors strike with deadly precision.
banner-of-har-ganeth.body: A unit carrying the Banner of Har Ganeth improves the Armour Piercing characteristic of its combat weapons by 1.

black-dragon-egg.description: When a Black Dragon egg is eaten, the properties of the Dragon are temporarily passed on.
black-dragon-egg.body: Single use. During the Command sub-phase of their turn, the bearer of a Black Dragon Egg can consume it. Until the end of that turn, the model has a Toughness characteristic of 6 (which cannot be improved further) and gains noxious breath.

focus-familiar.description: The Wizard channels their spells through the eyes of an arcane homunculus.
focus-familiar.body:
Single use. The owner of a Focus Familiar may use it when they attempt to cast a spell. Place a marker (such as a Familiar model) completely within 12" of the owner. The range and all effects of the spell are measured from this marker, rather than from the owner. If the spell requires a line of sight, this is determined from the marker (which has a 360° vision arc).
*Extremely Common

pendant-of-khaeleth.description: The protection offered by this amulet grows to match the power of an enemy's attack.
pendant-of-khaeleth.body: The Pendant of Khaeleth gives its bearer a 5+ Ward save against any wounds suffered that were caused by an attack with a Strength of 4 or lower, and a 4+ Ward save against any wounds suffered that were caused by an attack with a Strength of 5 or higher.

black-staff.description: A Black Staff is the talisman of the High Mistresses of the Convent of Sorceresses.
black-staff.body: The bearer of the Black Staff may use it when attempting to cast a spell. If they do so, roll an extra D6 when making the Casting roll and discard the lowest result. However, if a double 1 is rolled on any two of the dice rolled, the spell is miscast.

the-guiding-eye.description: Set in black iron, this oval ruby grants mystical sight to the wearer.
the-guiding-eye.body: Single use. The bearer of the Guiding Eye and any unit they have joined may re-roll any failed rolls To Hit made during the Shooting phase.

thundermace.description: Chiselled from a foundation stone taken from the base of a skycastle and bound with meteoric iron, the weight of a collapsing castle explodes from the head of the Thundermace.
thundermace.body: Notes: Rather than attacking normally, the wielder of the Thundermace may choose to make a special 'Thunderstrike' attack. If they do, make a single roll To Hit. If this is successful, place a small (3") blast template so that its central hole is directly over the centre of the hit unit. Any enemy model whose base lies underneath the template risks being hit by this weapon.

tome-of-furion.description: Furion of Clar Karond inscribed his knowledge onto sheets of flayed skin.
tome-of-furion.body: The bearer of the Tome of Furion knows one more spell (chosen in the usual way) than is normal for their Level of Wizardry.

skullplucker.description: This heavy, spiked metal gauntlet was once worn by Big Agi Skullplucker, who enjoyed nothing more than twisting his enemies' heads off with this nasty-looking, bloodstained glove.
skullplucker.body: Killing Blow, Magical Attacks, Strike First

tenderiser.description: The destructive power bound into the twin heads of this massive two-ended club is enough to shatter a boulder with one strike.
tenderiser.body: Extra Attacks (+1), Magical Attacks, Multiple Wounds (D3), Strike Last

mastodon-armour.description: This massive suit of armour was forged by the Chaos Dwarfs in exchange for many captives.
mastodon-armour.body: The Mastodon Armour is a suit of full plate armour. In addition, its wearer has a 6+ Ward save against any wounds suffered.

executioner-s-axe.description: A single blow from this huge, black-bladed weapon can cut any opponent in half.
executioner-s-axe.body: Notes: When making a roll To Wound for a hit caused with the Executioner's Axe, a roll of 2+ is always a success, regardless of the target's Toughness.

gut-maw.description: The wearer of this polished gut-plate is reinvigorated by the life force of their defeated enemies.
gut-maw.body: The Gut Maw is a suit of heavy armour. In addition, for each unsaved wound the wearer causes during a Challenge, they recover a single lost Wound.

rune-maw.description: Hung with stolen Dwarfen talismans, the Rune Maw roars its anger when it detects magic.
rune-maw.body: When an enemy Wizard chooses a unit carrying the Rune Maw as the target of a spell, roll a D6. On a 3+, the Wizard's controlling player must choose another target. If there is no other viable target in range, the spell cannot be cast.

cathayan-jet-pendant.description: Finely crafted Cathayan jet pendants are believed to protect against all forms of hostile magic.
cathayan-jet-pendant.body:
A Cathayan Jet Pendant gives its bearer a 6+ Ward save against any wounds suffered that were caused by a Magic Missile, a Magical Vortex, or an Assailment spell.
*Extremely Common

dragonhide-banner.description: This tattered trophy of a vanquished dragon passes its former owner's legendary ferocity onto its bearers.
dragonhide-banner.body: A unit carrying the Dragonhide Banner may re-roll any rolls To Hit of a natural 1. In addition, a unit carrying the Dragonhide Banner has the Flaming Attacks special rule.

bloodcleaver.description: This revolting, gore-encrusted weapon possesses a Vampiric energy, channelling the life force from its victims into its wielder.
bloodcleaver.body: Notes: Emissaries of the Great Maw only. If the wielder of the Bloodcleaver causes one or more unsaved wounds during the Combat phase, they recover a single lost Wound.

jade-lion.description: Jade Lions are revered in Cathay for their bravery, and amulets carved into their likeness inspire great courage.
jade-lion.body: The bearer of the Jade Lion and their unit may re-roll any failed Fear, Panic, Rally or Terror test.

hydra-s-tooth.description: Fangs are taken from the maw of a slain Hydra and crafted into deadly throwing weapons.
hydra-s-tooth.body:
A Hydra's Tooth is a missile weapon with the following profile:
Notes: This weapon can target a specific model within the target unit, such as a champion or a character.

daemon-slayer-scars.description: Daemonic beasts are hunted in the Warpstone Desert and bled into lead jars. This acidic ichor is used as warpaint, giving the wearer a truly terrifying appearance.
daemon-slayer-scars.body:
The bearer of Daemon-slayer Scars gains the Terror special rule.
*Extremely Common

bull-standard.description: The Bull Standard lends the strength of a charging Rhinox to the Ogres that march beneath it.
bull-standard.body: A unit carrying the Bull Standard may re-roll any failed rolls To Wound when resolving Impact Hits .

halfling-cookbook.description: The culinary secrets contained within the Halfling Cookbook are a source of great power.
halfling-cookbook.body: The bearer of the Halfling Cookbook increases their Command range, Dispel range and the range of a single spell chosen by their controlling player (not including range self spells) by 3".

fistful-of-laurels.description: Symbols of leadership snatched from the corpses of enemy commanders impress Ogres only briefly.
fistful-of-laurels.body:
Single use. The bearer of a Fistful of Laurels and their unit may re-roll the 2D6 when making a Break test.
*Extremely Common

mawseeker.description: Those tough enough to survive the pilgrimage to the Great Maw often return with part of themselves eaten away.
mawseeker.body: Models whose troop type is infantry only. This character has a +1 modifier to their Toughness characteristic. However, this character is also subject to the Stupidity special rule.

hellheart.description: Biting into the heart of a Chaos Spawn, the Ogre creates a vortex of magical anarchy.
hellheart.body: Single use. During the Command sub-phase of their turn, the bearer of the Hellheart may consume it. When they do so, they immediately lose a single Wound. However, until your next Start of Turn sub-phase, if any enemy Wizard rolls any natural double when making a Casting roll, the spell is miscast.

spangleshard.description: This dirt-encrusted and tarnished bauble barely resembles the fine Elven ornament it once was, but its protective powers still linger.
spangleshard.body: The Spangleshard gives its bearer a 4+ Ward save against any wounds suffered. However, if a natural 1 is rolled, the Spangleshard is destroyed and it cannot be used again.

longstrider.description: A Longstrider has hunted on the slopes of the mountains for decades, and is even capable of running down a sprinting ice elk.
longstrider.body: Models whose troop type is infantry only. This character has a +1 modifier to their Movement characteristic.

mountaineater.description: Those able to scale the tallest peaks ritually consume part of the mountain to mark their conquest.
mountaineater.body: Models whose troop type is infantry only. This character cannot be wounded by a roll To Wound of 2, regardless of the Strength of the attack.

giantbreaker.description: Any Ogre that has defeated a Giant in hand-to-hand combat can be, justifiably, supremely confident in their abilities.
giantbreaker.body: This character (but not their mount) has a +1 modifier to their Strength characteristic. However, this character cannot refuse a challenge and neither they, nor any unit they have joined, can Flee as a charge reaction.

beastkiller.description: As a sign of their prowess as a hunter of monsters, a Beastkiller will adorn their body with trophy horns and tusks.
beastkiller.body: Once per turn, this character may re-roll a single failed roll To Wound made against an enemy model with the Large Target special rule.

deathcheater.description: An Ogre that has escaped certain doom is considered blessed by the Great Maw. Not surprisingly, Deathcheaters tend to have impressive scars.
deathcheater.body: Once per game, you may make your opponent re-roll a single roll To Wound made against this character.

weeping-blade.description: This weapon weeps a venom so corrosive it can melt through armour with ease to deeply pierce and poison the flesh beneath.
weeping-blade.body: Magical Attacks, Multiple Wounds (D3), Poisoned Attacks

blade-of-nurglitch.description: Blessed by the Plaguelord of Clan Pestilens, even a scratch from this filth-encrusted weapon can turn into instant infection.
blade-of-nurglitch.body: Notes: Any enemy model that suffers one or more unsaved wounds from the Blade of Nurglitch must immediately make a Toughness test. If this test is failed, they suffer a -1 modifier to their Toughness characteristic (to a minimum of 1) for the remainder of the game.

the-fellblade.description: This most terrible of weapons was forged to slay Nagash himself. No foe can stand before it and even the wielder must eventually succumb to its baleful effects.
the-fellblade.body: Notes: Characters whose Troop Type is infantry only. No armour, Ward or Regeneration saves are permitted against wounds caused by this weapon. However, during the Command sub-phase of their turn, the wielder of the Fellblade must roll a D3. On a roll of 1, they lose a single Wound.

death-globe.description: Warlock Engineers often carry much improved and far more deadly versions of the globes wielded by Poisoned Wind Globadiers.
death-globe.body:
Notes: Single use. A model armed with a Death Globe must target a specific model within its target unit, such as a champion or a character. Make a roll To Hit as normal. If successful, centre a small (3") blast template over the target model. Any model whose base lies underneath the template must make an Initiative test. If this test is failed, they lose a single Wound.
*Extremely Common

kineater.description: Having achieved their rank by killing and eating a member of their own family in a pit fight, Kineaters are considered ruthless even by their own tribe.
kineater.body: Army General only. Unless this character is fleeing, friendly models within this character's Command range may re-roll any failed Panic or Rally test.

cannibal-totem.description: The Cannibal Totem protects those who devour the strong in honour of the Great Maw.
cannibal-totem.body: A unit carrying the Cannibal Totem gains the Regeneration (5+) special rule, but rolls only a single D6 when making a Pursuit roll (rather than the usual 2D6).

shadow-magnet.description: Warpstone-contaminated veins of ore can absorb light and cast an aura of deep, shadowy darkness.
shadow-magnet.body: Any enemy model that targets the bearer of the Shadow Magnet or any unit they have joined during the Shooting phase suffers an additional -1 To Hit modifier.

warpstone-amulet.description: The Warpstone Amulet radiates disharmony and confusion, so that anyone who attacks its bearer becomes dazed and bewildered.
warpstone-amulet.body: The Warpstone Amulet gives its bearer a 4+ Ward save against any wounds suffered that were caused by a non-magical enemy attack.

warpstone-armour.description: Cunningly wrought of warpstone-infused iron, this heavy suit of armour protects without stifling the Winds of Magic.
warpstone-armour.body:
The Warpstone Armour is a suit of heavy armour which may be purchased and worn by a Wizard, even if they do not have the option to be equipped with armour, a shield or barding, without penalty.
*Extremely Common

grut-s-sickle.description: Swinging the sickle of Grut the Bloodthirsty, a Butcher fuels their magic with the blood of their kin.
grut-s-sickle.body:
After making a Casting roll, the bearer of Grut's Sickle may use it to roll an additional D3 and add its result to their Casting roll. However, a single friendly model within 3" of the bearer immediately loses a single Wound.
Note that the result of this additional D3 cannot cause a miscast or a perfect invocation.

storm-banner.description: This ancient banner possesses the power to wrack the sky with storms and tear the heavens apart with its fury.
storm-banner.body: Single use. A unit carrying the Storm Banner may activate it during the Command sub-phase of their turn. Until your next Start of Turn sub-phase, enemy units cannot use the Fly (X) special rule and all enemy shooting suffers an additional -1 To Hit modifier.

skavenbrew.description: Brewed from warpstone and blood, Skavenbrew drives humble Skaven into a fighting frenzy.
skavenbrew.body:
Single use. Skaven Warlords and Skaven Chieftains only. During the Command sub-phase of their turn, if they are not engaged in combat, this character may attempt to distribute Skavenbrew to a unit they have joined by making a Leadership test (using their own Leadership). If this test is passed, until your next Start of Turn sub-phase this character and any unit they have joined gains the Frenzy special rule.
*Extremely Common

dwarf-hide-banner.description: Made from the tanned hides and shorn beards of vanquished Dwarfs, this banner fills the Skaven with the courage to face their ancient enemies.
dwarf-hide-banner.body: A unit carrying the Dwarf Hide Banner gains the Hatred (Dwarfs) and Stubborn special rules.

warp-condenser.description: This rune-inscribed power pack is covered with copper coil wiring, flywheels, and enchanted mechanisms to draw extra energy from the fickle Winds of Magic.
warp-condenser.body: The bearer of the Warp Condenser increases their Dispel range by 3". Additionally, when attempting to cast a Magic Missile spell, the bearer of the Warp Condenser gains a +1 modifier to their Casting roll. Finally, should they miscast a spell, the bearer of the Warp Condenser can re-roll the result rolled on the Miscast table.

banner-of-verminous-scurrying.description: A great, skittering urgency fills those that scurry beneath this tattered banner.
banner-of-verminous-scurrying.body: A unit carrying the Banner of Verminous Scurrying gains the Swiftstride special rule.

skalm.description: This rare healing balm is smeared on wounds and is even rumoured to prolong a Skaven's life.
skalm.body: Single use. During the Command sub-phase of their turn, the bearer of Skalm can use it. The model immediately recovers a single lost Wound and, until your next Start of Turn sub-phase, has a +1 modifier to their Toughness characteristic.

brass-orb.description: This fist-sized orb of whirling cogs is capable of opening a crack into the twisting Realm of Chaos.
brass-orb.body: Single use. Instead of attacking normally during the Combat phase, the bearer of the Brass Orb can toss it at a specific model within a unit they are engaged in combat with, such as a champion or a character. Make a single roll To Hit. If successful, the target model must make an Initiative test. If this test is failed, the target model is removed from play as a casualty.

grand-banner-of-superiority.description: This ragged shroud, emblazoned with clan signs, proclaims the superiority of the Warlord Clans.
grand-banner-of-superiority.body: When calculating its combat result, a unit carrying the Grand Banner of Superiority may claim an additional bonus of +D3 combat result points.

warpstone-tokens.description: Pieces of refined warpstone are consumed by power-hungry Skaven Wizards.
warpstone-tokens.body:
A Wizard may purchase up to three Warpstone Tokens, each of which is single use. Before making a Casting roll, a Wizard may choose to consume a single Warpstone Token. For each Token consumed, they may roll an additional D3 and add its result to their Casting roll. However, for each natural 1 that is rolled, the Wizard loses a single Wound.
*Extremely Common

the-screaming-banner.description: Even the bravest warriors tremble in the presence of a haunted banner that wails a constant dirge.
the-screaming-banner.body: When an enemy unit makes a Leadership test due to Fear caused by a unit carrying the Screaming Banner, it must roll an extra D6 and discard the lowest result.

storm-daemon.description: Created by the Warlock Engineers of Clan Skryre, this warpstone-powered device crackles with barely contained power.
storm-daemon.body:
This model can cast the following Bound spell, with a Power Level of 1:
Type | Magic Missile
Casting Value | 8+
Range | 18"
The target enemy unit suffers D3+1 Strength 5 hits, each with an AP of -2.

banner-of-the-barrows.description: Woven from the wind and the cold, the chill of this banner touches the hearts of those who stand before it.
banner-of-the-barrows.body: Wight Lord Battle Standard Bearer only. During the Combat phase, when a unit carrying the Banner of the Barrows makes a roll To Hit, a roll of 3+ is always a success, regardless of the target's Weapon Skill.

drakenhof-banner.description: The infamous Count Vlad von Carstein had thrall Necromancers enchant his household standard to sustain his bodyguard.
drakenhof-banner.body: If a unit carrying the Drakenhof Banner has the Regeneration (X+) special rule, it improves the armour value of its Regeneration save by 1.

standard-of-hellish-vigour.description: The restless essence of the Vampire whose flesh was flayed to craft this banner invigorates the Undead nearby.
standard-of-hellish-vigour.body: A unit carrying the Standard of Hellish Vigour gains the Reserve Move special rule.

sword-of-kings.description: This accursed blade of ancient and ageless design thirsts constantly for the souls of its wielder's enemies.
sword-of-kings.body: Notes: The wielder of the Sword of Kings strikes a Killing Blow if they roll a natural 5 or 6 when making a roll To Wound, rather than the usual 6.

cautious-shield.description: This large, magical shield emphasises an already prominent trait of Skaven nature.
cautious-shield.body: The Cautious Shield is a shield. In addition, its bearer may choose to wield it with two hands when their combat is chosen during Step 1.1 of any Choose & Fight Combat sub-phase. If they do, until the end of this Combat phase it improves its armour save by 3, but their Attacks characteristic is reduced to 0.

dreadlance.description: Once wielded by an infamous Vampire knight, this lance is uncannily accurate, said to find its target even in the dark of night.
dreadlance.body: Notes: Models whose troop type is cavalry or monster only. The Dreadlance can only be used during a turn in which the wielder charged. In subsequent turns (or if the wielder did not charge) the model must use its hand weapon instead. The wielder of the Dreadlance may re-roll any failed rolls To Hit made whilst using it.

blood-drinker.description: This long, slender blade greedily drinks the blood of its victims, their life force revitalising its master.
blood-drinker.body: Notes: If the wielder of Blood Drinker causes one or more unsaved wounds during the Combat phase, they recover a single lost Wound.

frostblade.description: This blade of blue ice-steel is bound with such deadly spells that its merest touch will suck the soul from its victim's body.
frostblade.body: Notes: Any enemy model that suffers one or more unsaved wounds from the Frostblade must immediately make a Toughness test. If this test is failed, they gain the Strike Last special rule and must reduce their Initiative characteristic to 1 for the remainder of the game.

the-flayed-hauberk.description: Stitched from the flesh of countless victims, the wearer of the Flayed Hauberk is enshrouded and protected by the souls of the damned.
the-flayed-hauberk.body: The Flayed Hauberk is a suit of heavy armour which may be worn by a Wizard without penalty. In addition, its wearer has a 6+ Ward save against any wounds suffered.

skull-staff.description: The Skull Staff constantly whispers to its bearer, revealing the secrets of their foes and predicting the ebb and flow of the Winds of Magic.
skull-staff.body:
The bearer of the Skull Staff increases their Dispel range by 3" and, when attempting a Wizardly dispel, may apply a +1 modifier to their Dispel roll.
Note that this is a modifier to the result of a roll – it does not negate a roll of a natural double 1.

von-carstein-ring.description: An ancient heirloom of the lords of Sylvania, this ring is known to make a Vampire carrying it almost impossible to kill.
von-carstein-ring.body: Vampires only. Single use. When the wearer of the Von Carstein Ring loses their last Wound, roll a D6. On a roll of 2+, the Wound is not lost.

hand-of-dust.description: The severed hand of the Great Necromancer himself, the mere proximity of this withered appendage can drain all life and vitality from mortals, leaving them as desiccated husks.
hand-of-dust.body:
Necromancers only. This model can cast the following Bound spell, with a Power Level of 2. Roll a D6 each time the Hand of Dust is used. On a roll of 1, it crumbles to dust and cannot be used again:
Type | Assailment
Casting Value | 9+
Range | Combat
The target enemy unit suffers 2D6 Strength 5 hits, each with an AP of -1.

helm-of-commandment.description: This ancient and corroded helmet can be used to infuse Undead servants with the wearer's sentience, making them formidable fighters.
helm-of-commandment.body: Necromancers and Wights only. During the Command sub-phase of their turn, this character may attempt to enhance the sentience of those around them by making a Leadership test (using their own Leadership). If this test is passed, until your next Start of Turn sub-phase this character and any unit they have joined gains a +D3 modifier to their Weapon Skill characteristic (to a maximum of 10).

the-accursed-armour.description: Some strange flaw renders the wearer of this armour resilient beyond measure, yet robs them of dexterity.
the-accursed-armour.body: Models whose troop type is infantry or cavalry only. The Accursed Armour is a suit of full plate armour. In addition, its wearer has a +1 modifier to their Toughness characteristic, but suffers a -1 modifier to their Weapon Skill and Initiative characteristics (to a minimum of 1).

crown-of-the-damned.description: The wearer of the Crown of the Damned draws revitalising energies from the spirits imprisoned within it, but at times their eternal wailing can become overpowering.
crown-of-the-damned.body: The Crown of the Damned gives its wearer a 4+ Ward save against any wounds suffered. However, due to the wailing of the spirits trapped within the crown, its wearer is also subject to the Stupidity special rule.

sceptre-of-de-noirot.description: The Necromancer de Noirot suffered a terrible demise when he invoked the power of this sceptre and raised more of the Undead than he could control.
sceptre-of-de-noirot.body: The bearer of the Sceptre of de Noirot may attempt to resurrect the fallen by using the Invocation of Nehek special rule twice during their Command sub-phase (rather than the usual once). Roll a D6 each time the sceptre is used. On a roll of 1, the bearer loses a single Wound.

many-arms.description: The Daemon has been blessed with a surfeit of grasping and clawing appendages.
many-arms.body:
This model has a +1 modifier to its Attacks characteristic.
*Extremely Common

daemonic-robes.description: The Daemon is clad in shimmering robes that deflect the fury of incoming blows.
daemonic-robes.body: This model cannot be wounded by a roll To Wound of 2, regardless of the Strength of the attack.

standard-of-chaotic-glory.description: This banner flickers in and out of existence, creating a tear in reality through which the power of Chaos flows.
standard-of-chaotic-glory.body: Daemonic Locus only. Friendly Daemonic units gain a +1 modifier to their Leadership characteristic whilst within this character's Command range (to a maximum of 10).

winged-horror.description: Gigantic wings sprout from the Daemon's back, allowing it to dive upon the unprepared foe.
winged-horror.body: Daemonic Heralds whose troop type is regular infantry only. This model gains the Fly (8) and Swiftstride special rules.

totem-of-eternal-war.description: The power of the æther flows from this accursed icon and into the Daemons that march beneath it.
totem-of-eternal-war.body: Daemonic Locus only. Friendly Daemonic units reduce the number of wounds suffered due to the Daemonic Instability special rule by an additional D3 whilst within the Command range of this model.

spell-eater.description: Like a predator feasting upon the flesh of its prey, the Daemon hungrily consumes the magic of its enemies.
spell-eater.body: This model may be nominated to attempt a Wizardly Dispel, as if it were a Wizard. For the purposes of Wizardly Dispel attempts, this model counts as a Level 2 Wizard.

armour-of-khorne.description: Clad in rune-laden armour, the Daemon's hide is all but immune to the blows of mere mortals.
armour-of-khorne.body: The Armour of Khorne is a suit of heavy armour. In addition, its wearer has a 5+ Ward save against any wounds suffered.

collar-of-khorne.description: The dread sigils inscribed upon this brass necklace provide protection against the most powerful of magics.
collar-of-khorne.body:
The wearer of a Collar of Khorne improves its Magic Resistance by 1. For example, a model with Magic Resistance (-2) wearing a Collar of Khorne would have Magic Resistance (-3).
*Extremely Common

cloak-of-mist-shadows.description: This cloak frees the wearer from the bonds of their physical form, allowing them to move through solid matter like a ghost.
cloak-of-mist-shadows.body: Necromancers whose troop type is infantry only. The wearer of the Cloak of Mist & Shadows gains the Ethereal special rule.

banner-of-unholy-victory.description: Scenes from a million battles fill the minds of those that gaze upon this banner.
banner-of-unholy-victory.body: When calculating its combat result, a unit carrying the Banner of Unholy Victory may claim an additional bonus of +D3 combat result points.

axe-of-khorne.description: Screaming with the power of a bound Daemon, this unholy blade thirsts for the blood of mortals.

icon-of-endless-war.description: This brass standard constantly drips blood, the smell of which drives all of Khorne's followers mad with battle-lust.
icon-of-endless-war.body: When a unit carrying the Banner of Rage declares a charge, it may re-roll its Charge roll.

skull-totem.description: The pole of this banner is thick-set with the captured skulls of Khorne's victims, each marked with a brass-etched rune of slaughter.
skull-totem.body: A unit carrying the Skull Totem (but not its mounts) gains the Furious Charge special rule.

ther-blade.description: The Daemon's weapon flickers in and out of reality, slipping through armour and into the soft flesh beneath.
ther-blade.body: No armour saves are permitted against wounds caused by this Daemon's hand weapon (Ward and Regeneration saves can be attempted as normal).

great-standard-of-sundering.description: Runes of warding crowd close about this banner, their power focussed to deny enemy Wizards access to the Winds of Magic.
great-standard-of-sundering.body: Any enemy Wizard that can draw a line of sight to the model carrying the Great Standard of Sundering suffers a -1 modifier to any Casting roll it makes.

spoilpox-scrivener.description: A Spoilpox Scrivener scrutinises the work of Nurgle's Daemons as they spread and record their master's blessings.
spoilpox-scrivener.body: Daemonic Heralds whose troop type is infantry only. Whilst within this model's Command range, friendly units with the Daemons of Nurgle special rule may re-roll any rolls To Hit of a natural 1.

might-of-khorne.description: Blessed by its patron, the Daemon's massive limbs bulge with strength and power.
might-of-khorne.body: This model has a +1 modifier to its Strength characteristic.

sloppity-bilepiper.description: The infectious tunes of a Bilepiper fill their companions with joyous murrain.
sloppity-bilepiper.body: Daemonic Heralds whose troop type is infantry only. Friendly units with the Daemons of Nurgle special rule that begin their movement within this model's Command range have a +1 modifier to their Movement characteristic.

rotten-icon.description: Pus and slime drip constantly from the Rotten Icon, turning the dry earth into noisome mud.
rotten-icon.body: Enemy units cannot claim any bonus combat result points for being engaged with the rear arc of a unit carrying the Rotten Icon.

icon-of-eternal-virulence.description: Each drop of blood spilt beneath this dank shroud becomes infected with every affliction known to Nurgle.
icon-of-eternal-virulence.body: When calculating its combat result, a unit carrying the Icon of Eternal Virulence may claim an additional bonus of +1 combat result point (to a maximum of +3) for each unsaved wound caused by a Poisoned Attack.

stream-of-contagion.description: Opening its gullet wide, the Daemon unleashes a stream of noxious bile upon its foes.

nurgling-infestation.description: Multitudinous Nurglings swarm about the Great Unclean One and nestle within the folds of its skin.
nurgling-infestation.body:
Great Unclean One only. Whilst engaged in combat, this model may make an additional D6 attacks. These attacks are resolved at Initiative 2, with a Weapon Skill and Strength of 2, and with an AP of -. Additionally, when this model loses its last Wound, place a Nurgling Swarm of D3 models so that each model is within 3" of this model before removing this model from play.
Note that these Nurgling Swarms are not worth any Victory Points.

infernal-enrapturess.description: Weaving a discordant melody upon an accursed harp, the Daemon enraptures those with the mage-sight.
infernal-enrapturess.body: Daemonic Heralds whose troop type is infantry only. Whilst within this character's Command range, friendly Daemons of Slaanesh that are also Wizards (not including this model) may apply a +1 modifier to any Casting roll they make. Whilst within this character's Command range, enemy Wizards suffer a -1 modifier to any Casting roll they make.

allure-of-slaanesh.description: The Daemon is possessed of a peculiarly captivating and disarming visage.
allure-of-slaanesh.body: Enemy units must make a Leadership test before making any rolls To Hit against this model during the Combat phase. If this test is failed, only rolls of a natural 6 will hit.

standard-of-seeping-decay.description: A pervasive aura of pestilence surrounds this moth-eaten banner, sapping the health of all around it.
standard-of-seeping-decay.body: During the Combat phase, a unit carrying the Standard of Seeping Decay may re-roll any rolls To Wound of a natural 1.

trappings-of-nurgle.description: The Daemon is bedecked in rusted armour and rotted robes.
trappings-of-nurgle.body: The Trappings of Nurgle is a suit of armour that gives its wearer an armour value of 4+ which cannot be improved in any way.

rapturous-standard.description: Gripped by a strange euphoria, enemy formations crumble into confusion in the presence of this standard.
rapturous-standard.body: Any enemy unit that charges the front arc of a unit carrying the Rapturous Standard makes a disordered charge.

siren-song.description: The Daemon sings an alluring song, drawing its enemies to their doom.
siren-song.body:
Single use. At the start of your opponent's Declare Charges & Charge Reactions sub-phase, nominate a single enemy unit that is able to declare a charge against this model (or its unit). That enemy unit must make a Leadership test
Leadership Tests. If this test is passed, the unit may act as normal. However, if this test is failed, it must declare a charge against this model (or its unit).

banner-of-acquiescence.description: Beneath the shadow of this standard, enemies lower their weapons and bear their breasts to the blades of the foe.
banner-of-acquiescence.body: A single enemy unit engaged in combat with the bearer of the Banner of Acquiescence suffers a -D3 modifier to its Weapon Skill and Initiative characteristics (to a minimum of 1).

soporific-musk.description: The Daemon exudes a heady and cloying musk that dulls the wits of its enemies.
soporific-musk.body:
Enemy models engaged in combat with this model cannot use the Strike First special rule. Enemy models that do not have the Strike First special rule become subject to the Strike Last special rule instead.
*Extremely Common

staff-of-change.description: The mere presence of this staff causes all natural things to cry out in pain as it reshapes the world according to the Daemon's whim.
staff-of-change.body: Notes: Any enemy model that suffers one or more unsaved wounds from the Staff of Change must immediately make a Toughness test. If this test is failed, the wounded model loses all of its remaining Wounds.

power-vortex.description: The Winds of Magic billow about the Daemon, but remain beyond the reach of its enemies.
power-vortex.body: Whilst within this Wizard's dispel range, enemy Wizards suffer a -1 modifier to their Casting rolls.

iridescent-corona.description: Glittering multi-coloured fire encases the Daemon's form, confounding the aim of the enemy.
iridescent-corona.body:
Any enemy model that targets this model during the Shooting phase suffers an additional -1 To Hit modifier.
*Extremely Common

siren-standard.description: A Daemonic Siren is imprisoned in this banner, its seductive song lulling the senses of all who hear it.
siren-standard.body: If an enemy unit charged by a unit carrying the Siren Standard wishes to Flee (or Fire & Flee) as a charge reaction, it must first make a Leadership test. If this test is passed, the unit may Flee (or Fire & Flee). However, if this test is failed, the unit must Hold.

will-of-tzeentch.description: The Daemon perceives the intricate pathways of fate and can tug upon the strands of destiny should it so desire.
will-of-tzeentch.body: Once per round, this model may re-roll a single D6. This may be a D6 rolled on its own, as part of a batch of dice, or as part of a multiple dice roll.

icon-of-sorcery.description: The runes upon this banner swirl and distort as they magnify the sorcerous might of the Horrors that caper beneath it.
icon-of-sorcery.body:
Pink Horrors only. When a unit carrying the Icon of Sorcery casts a Bound spell, it does so with a power level equal to twice its Rank Bonus.
*Extremely Common

curse-of-the-revenant.description: Through magic, bloodletting or sheer force of will, the strength of this Vampire to survive the centuries is beyond compare.
curse-of-the-revenant.body: This Vampire has a +1 modifier to its Wounds characteristic.

banner-of-discord.description: The air around this warped banner shimmers with the explosive unbinding of enemy spells.
banner-of-discord.body: A unit carrying the Banner of Discord gains the Magic Resistance (-3) special rule. In addition, friendly units within 6" of the model carrying this standard gain the Magic Resistance (-1) special rule.

twin-heads.description: Possessed of two personalities and two intellects, this two-headed Daemon is a master of the Winds of Magic.
twin-heads.body:
This model knows one more spell (chosen in the usual way) than is normal for their Level of Wizardry.
Note that this does not increase the Wizard's Level.

supernatural-horror.description: This Vampire is hideous to look upon, having long since forsaken the trappings of nobility and beauty and embraced the beast within.
supernatural-horror.body: This Vampire gains the Terror special rule.

enrapturing-gaze.description: The beguiling gaze of this Daemon holds the attention of all foolish enough to meet it.
enrapturing-gaze.body:
Enemy models engaged in combat with this model cannot use the Inspiring Presence special rule of their General.
*Extremely Common

beguile.description: The Vampire has an entrancing gaze that mesmerises their foes, rendering them all but incapable of causing the Vampire harm.
beguile.body: Enemy units must make a Leadership test before making any rolls To Hit against this Vampire during the Combat phase. If this test is failed, only rolls of a natural 6 will hit.

flying-horror.description: The Vampire is able to take to the skies with great, membranous wings, or perhaps can even metamorphose into a monstrous bat.
flying-horror.body: Models whose troop type is infantry only. This Vampire gains the Fly (10) rule, but cannot join a unit.

banner-of-change.description: So saturated is this banner with the power of change that it distorts and mutates everything around it.
banner-of-change.body: At the start of the Combat phase, a single enemy unit engaged in combat with this model suffers 3D6 Strength 2 hits, each with an AP of -.

lord-of-the-night.description: The Vampire howls into the cold night, their cry answered by the baying of countless dark creatures.
lord-of-the-night.body: During the Command sub-phase of their turn, this Vampire may attempt to resurrect fallen creatures of the night by making a Leadership test (using their own Leadership). If this test is passed, a single friendly unit of Fell Bats, Bat Swarms or Dire Wolves that is within 12" of this model recovers D6 lost Wounds.

master-of-the-black-arts.description: The Winds of Magic bend easily to the will of this Vampire, so matchless is their magical prowess.
master-of-the-black-arts.body: This Vampiric Power may only be taken by a Vampire Count that is a Level 2 Wizard, or by a Vampire Thrall that is a Level 1 Wizard. This Vampire increases their Level of Wizardry by 1.

aspect-of-the-bear.description: Elves are usually lithe and slight of build, but those who adopt the aspect of the bear are strong and muscular warriors.
aspect-of-the-bear.body: Infantry or cavalry only. A character who adopts the Aspect of the Bear increases their Strength and Toughness characteristics by 1.

aspect-of-the-hound.description: Fighting as a pack, those in the kindred of the hound work together to bring down larger prey.
aspect-of-the-hound.body: A character who adopts the Aspect of the Hound, and any unit they have joined, may re-roll any rolls To Hit of a natural 1 during the Combat phase.

aspect-of-the-boar.description: The kindred of the boar are aggressive fighters who charge into the foe with reckless abandon.
aspect-of-the-boar.body: A character who adopts the Aspect of the Boar improves the Armour Piercing characteristics of its weapon(s) by 1 during a turn in which it charged and gains the Impact Hits (1) special rule.

glamour-weave-kindred.description: Though the Glamour Weave Kindred is far smaller than the others, its members are all potent spellcasters who play an important role in ensuring balance is maintained within Athel Loren.
glamour-weave-kindred.body: Wood Elf Mages only. A character belonging to the Glamour Weave Kindred has a 5+ Ward save and gains the Tree Spirit special rule.

aspect-of-the-cat.description: Hunting from the shadows, the kindred of the cat are experts at hunting down prized game.
aspect-of-the-cat.body: A character who adopts the Aspect of the Cat gains the Armour Bane (1) special rule and may re-roll any failed rolls To Hit during a challenge.

eternal-kindred.description: Those who dwell within the Eternal Kindreds spend the cold winters guarding Athel Loren's most sacred glades and groves.
eternal-kindred.body: Infantryonly. A character belonging to the Eternal Kindred, and any unit they have joined, may re-roll any rolls To Hit of a natural 1 during the Combat phase. In addition, a character belonging to the Eternal Kindred, and any unit they have joined, may re-roll any failed rolls To Wound during the Combat phase while within 6" of a special feature.

the-sword-of-reason.description: This great blade is sometimes wielded by Yuan Bo when his duties require him to enforce the Celestial Dragon's will upon the unruly.
the-sword-of-reason.body: Notes: The wielder of the Sword of Reason strikes a Killing Blow if they roll a natural 5 or 6 when making a roll To Wound, rather than the usual 6.

scout-kindred.description: Sometimes known as wayfarers or sentinels, the Scout Kindreds guard the borders of Athel Loren and observe the movements of those who wander too close.
scout-kindred.body: Infantry only. A character belonging to the Scout Kindred gains the Quick Shot and Scouts special rules.

jade-blade-of-the-great-fleet.description: The Jade Blade is an ancient weapon fashioned from the fang of a Lumbrian sea monster. Imbued with the monster's regenerative powers, it continually heals its wielder.
jade-blade-of-the-great-fleet.body: Notes: The wielder of the Jade Blade of the Great Fleet gains the Regeneration (5+) special rule.

wild-rider-kindred.description: Those in command of the Wild Rider Kindreds are truly embodiments of their liege lord, reckless and ferocious almost to a fault.
wild-rider-kindred.body: Wood Elf Nobles only. A character belonging to the Wild Rider Kindred must be mounted on an Elven Steed or Great Stag and may only wear light armour. In addition, they gain the Counter Charge, Frenzy, Furious Charge and Talismanic Tattoos special rules.

the-brazen-blade.description: Crafted in the forges of Nan-Gau, this unusual weapon carves deep wounds that no magic can heal.
the-brazen-blade.body: Notes: Enemy models are not permitted a Ward or Regeneration save against an attack made with this weapon if the wielder rolls a natural 6 when making a roll To Wound.

the-sword-of-nan-gau.description: This shimmering blade strikes with a life of its own, seeking any weakness in the armour of those that serve the Ruinous Powers.

the-wrath-of-xen-yang.description: Supposedly once wielded by the Celestial Dragon himself, this long and elegant spear burns with Dragon-fire.
the-wrath-of-xen-yang.body: Notes: Enemy models cannot make Regeneration saves against a wound caused by this weapon.

spirit-longma-spear.description: Made from the horn of the Great Spirit Longma Tian Wu and able to pierce any armour, heroes of Cathay carry this spear into battle with pride.
spirit-longma-spear.body: Notes: Models whose troop type is cavalry, monster or chariot only. A Cathayan lance's Strength and Armour Piercing modifiers apply only during a turn in which the wielder charged.

the-armour-of-the-warbird.description: The wearer of the Armour of the Warbird takes to the skies to strike at their enemies from above.
the-armour-of-the-warbird.body: Models whose troop type is regular infantry or heavy infantry only. The Armour of the Warbird is a suit of heavy armour. In addition, the wearer gains the Counter Charge, Fly (9) and Swiftstride special rules. However, the bearer cannot join a unit.

jade-armour-of-beichai.description: Crafted in secret in the city of Beichai, this jade armour glows from within with unwholesome power.
jade-armour-of-beichai.body: The Jade Armour of Beichai is a suit of full plate armour. In addition, the wearer of the Jade Armour has a 5+ Ward save against any wounds suffered and gains the Magic Resistance (-2) special rule.

vermilion-quills.description: Great heroes of Grand Cathay are awarded tokens of favour in the form of a Vermilion warbird's tail feather, tokens which are said to bless the bearer with unrivalled fortune.
vermilion-quills.body:
0-1 per model. Single Use. The bearer of a Vermilion Quill (but not their mount) can re-roll any failed rolls To Hit and/or To Wound made during the Combat phase.
*Extremely Common

the-mantle-of-heaven.description: Woven from silk harvested from the slopes of Kunlan, the wearer of these robes is filled with a measure of the Celestial Dragon's essence.
the-mantle-of-heaven.body: Models whose troop type is infantry or cavalry only. May be worn with other armour. The wearer of the Mantle of Heaven improves their armour value by 2 (to a maximum of 2+) against non-magical shooting attacks.

crown-of-jade.description: Hostile magic recoils from the wearer of this gleaming crown of office.
crown-of-jade.body: The Crown of Jade gives its wearer a 4+ Ward save against any wounds suffered that were caused by a Magic Missile, a Magical Vortex, or an Assailment spell.

shield-of-nan-gau.description: Carved from a section of the Great Bastion, the Shield of Nan-Gau is a massive stone and iron shield.
